bio.text: J.D. Mesnard, a Republican, represents District 13 in the Arizona State Senate; he is not running for re-election to it in 2026 and is a candidate for San Marcos District justice of the peace in Maricopa County in the November 3, 2026 general election.

According to his legislative biography, Mesnard previously served eight years in the Arizona House of Representatives, including as Speaker of the House for his last two years, and is adjunct faculty at Arizona State University and Mesa Community College.

He lives in Chandler and, according to Ballotpedia, holds a bachelor of music from Arizona State University (2002), a master's in public administration from DeVry University's Keller Graduate School of Management (2006), and an MBA from the University of Phoenix (2006).
